title: National Archives photos of EG&G/Sandia underground operations at the Nevada Test Site

tellings.quote: test and training range. There's a series of photographs in the national archives ranging from 1972 to at that time 1992 before uh Martin Marietta purchased Sandia back in 1993.

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb says the US National Archives, the government's official records store, holds a series of photographs taken from 1972 to 1992. According to him, they show underground work at the Nevada Test Site, a government nuclear testing ground, carried out by EG&G, a defence contractor, and Sandia, a US nuclear weapons laboratory, before the aerospace company Martin Marietta took over Sandia in 1993. He raises it because it would point to hidden underground operations in the same desert as the secret base known as Area 51.
